findings.observed: The plan says semantic confidence, governance confidence, and evidence strength must remain distinct.
findings.governed_meaning: CAV2-D23 and CAV2-D40 define evidence_confidence and commitment_confidence as the two object-confidence axes and forbid a third challenge or aggregate axis. EvidenceStrength belongs to evidence assessment.
findings.remediation: Use evidence_confidence, commitment_confidence, and evidence_strength in successor authored source. Treat semantic confidence and governance confidence as rejected aliases.

findings.observed: The source separates lifecycle axes but does not select the closed semantic lifecycle values for event payloads.
findings.governed_meaning: OntologyLifecycleState is now defined, but its executable value vocabulary remains owner-unselected.
findings.remediation: Resolve one exact lifecycle vocabulary before JSON Schema implementation; do not reuse package workflow status values implicitly.

findings.observed: The current runtime schemas implement the thin mechanics witness and do not carry the complete selected governed-node facets.
findings.governed_meaning: The selected architecture requires closed node, relation, challenge, governance, exact-reference, selector, and projection records.
findings.remediation: Under a later CA2-ROUTE-IMPLEMENT authorization, replace or version the thin payload contract from schema-semantics.json and implement every NEG-GON witness.

findings.observed: Existing CyberAlchemy-v2 ontology packages use divergent node fields, relation forms, lifecycle labels, and confidence shapes.
findings.governed_meaning: No source-local distinction may be normalized away or placed into a generic property bag.
findings.remediation: Inventory and map each package only after the governed-node witness is accepted; route unknown fields to TypedResidue.
findings.owner_route: Ontology package owners plus migration owner

findings.observed: The immutable proposal still says not-selected because it records its pre-decision candidate epoch.
findings.governed_meaning: CAL-GONA-0005 selects the exact proposal digest without rewriting historical proposal bytes.
findings.remediation: Consumers must join the proposal to CAL-GONA-0005 rather than infer current selection from the proposal status field.

findings.observed: No accepted Ontology Lifecycle Language Context View exists.
findings.governed_meaning: Controlled direct English can simplify non-normative explanations but cannot rename stable identifiers or change formal definitions.
findings.remediation: Keep ASD-STE100-style direct prose as a candidate presentation rule until a language context view is owner-selected.

findings.observed: The proposal requires typed residue but its definition evidence selector list omits canonical CAV2-D18.
findings.governed_meaning: TypedResidue must specialize CAV2-D18 rather than being redefined locally.
findings.remediation: This pack binds CAV2-D18 explicitly. A future proposal successor or source-map refresh should add the selector without rewriting CAL-PROP-0004.

claim_ceiling: This audit covers only the declared W1 dependency set. Unrelated repository or ontology drift was not inspected and cannot be inferred from this result.
